headlines.title: DoorDash in advanced talks to acquire Instacart: WSJ
headlines.summary: Market Domination Overtime host Brooke DIPalma summarizes The Wall Street Journal reporting on DoorDash (DASH) in advanced talks to acquire Instacart — valued at $17 billion — in a deal that could be completed in the coming week.

headlines.title: DoorDash in Talks to Acquire Instacart in Potential $17 Billion Deal
headlines.summary: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in a deal that could value the company at approximately $17 billion, according to reports from The Wall Street Journal and Reuters. The Journal first reported the discussions Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Held Early Acquisition Talks With A Delivery Rival
headlines.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) has reportedly held early talks with Instacart about a possible acquisition. Instacart is said to be exploring a potential sale and has engaged DoorDash in preliminary discussions on terms. Any combination of DoorDash and Instacart would bring together two major US players in restaurant and grocery delivery. These early DoorDash and Instacart sale talks only capture one piece of the broader investment story for the delivery platform.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock May Be Fully Priced Despite Drone Delivery News
headlines.summary: DoorDash has seen its share price fall in recent months after a strong multi year run. That puts fresh focus on whether the current valuation still lines up with what the business earns. With fresh headlines on drone delivery and regulatory settlements, the question is how much of that story is already embedded in the stock price. Over the past 3 years the stock has gained 130.

headlines.title: CART Stock Jumps As DoorDash Acquisition Talks Reportedly Heat Up Toward Possible $17B Deal
headlines.summary: According to a report from The Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the matter, a deal between DoorDash and Instacart could be completed as soon as this week.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
